professionalSummary: Service coordinator for the resource management console pre‑release programme, responsible for staging environment management, release rehearsal execution, and rehearsal incident drills.
Maintained service runbooks and availability report templates used by the live service team, updating them after each rehearsal.
Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success during pre‑release change windows.
Prepared rehearsal reports documenting known limitations and hand‑over items for the live service team.
Managed staging coordination, release rehearsals, incident drills, runbook maintenance and rehearsal reports over approximately two years.
experienceHighlights: Ran the staging environment for the resource management console as the service coordinator for the pre‑release programme, executing the release rehearsal checklist for eleven candidate releases and leading the rehearsal incident drills with the engineering team. (src_1adc9fc86cdf)
Maintained the service runbooks and the availability report template that the live service team used, updating the runbooks after each rehearsal with the steps that had failed. (src_faf0d7237852)

Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success in the pre‑release change window; production changes and customer‑facing incidents were handled by the live service team under its own on‑call rota, which I was not part of. (src_a6e8e28a0cec)
Wrote the rehearsal report after each drill, listing the known limitation that staging carried synthetic customer accounts only and the hand‑over items for the live service team. (src_044e73bdd899)

Responsibilities included staging coordination, release rehearsals, incident drills, runbook maintenance and rehearsal reports for the console's pre‑release programme over about two years. (src_f65589e805b0)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: the release rehearsal checklist with the drill log for eleven releases and one rehearsal report, with the staging environment's release identifiers as a verification trail. (src_3f0eef48bb65)
skills: Documentation of limitations and hand‑over items
